rows.abstract:

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING OPEN ACCESS IN DATA TRANSMISSION, PROVIDING ADDITIONAL POWERS TO THE NATIONAL TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMMISSION
rows.abstract:
Defines \"data transmission\" as the process of sending digital or digitized analog signal over a
communication medium to one or more computing network/s, communication or electronic device/s; 
it enables the transfer and communication of devices in a point-to-point, point-to-multipoint and 
multipoint-to-multipoint environments; includes the provision of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP)
services but does not include the provision of basic telephone services.

Provides for the organization, operation and regulation of the data transmission industry through open access approach; spectrum allocation, recall, and reallocation; setting of performance standards; arms-length transactions and transparency; fair competition; and restriction on the issuance of TRO or Writ of Preliminary Injunction.

Also includes among its provisions:  sections on prohibited acts; administrative penalties; and adjustment for inflation; and rights of data transmission service users and responsibilities of data transmission service providers.

rows.title_short: Reverting Fishponds Which Have Been Unutilized Or Abandoned For A Period Of Three (3) Years To Forestlands
rows.abstract:
Seeks to shorten the period to revert fishponds  which have been unutilized and abandoned to forest lands from five (5) years to three (3) years  and shall be immediately rehabilitated and reforested.

Mandates the Department of Agriculture and Department of Environment and Natural Resources to jointly set guidelines in determining abandoned, undeveloped or underutilized fishponds covered by FLAs which shall be reverted into forestlands and rehabilitated.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES IN THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGIC WATERS, PRESCRIBING THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF FOREIGN SHIPS AND AIRCRAFT EXERCISING THE RIGHT OF ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES PASSAGE
rows.abstract:
Defines several terms such as:  Archipelagic sea lane; Archipelagic sea lane passage; Archipelagic water; Associated protective measure; Hydrographic survey; Oceanographic survey; Right of innocent passage; and Territorial sea.

Declares that foreign ships or aircraft, including research or hydrographic survey ships or aircraft, shall not conduct oceanographic or hydrographic surveys, unless prior permission to do so from the appropriate agency of the Government has been obtained.

Enumerates the different prohibitions to foreign ships/fishing vessels and aircraft, while exercising the right of archipelagic sea lanes passage; and provides for compliance with navigational regulations, procedures and traffic scheme.

rows.author: F036

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING AND DEFINING THE MARITIME ZONES UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
States that the maritime zones of the Philippines comprise the internal waters, archipelagic waters, territorial sea, contiguous zone, exclusive economic zone (EEZ) and continental shelf; and provides that all territories shall generate their respective maritime zones in accordance with international
law.

Declares that the Philippines exercises sovereignty/sovereign rights and jurisdiction, including the right to explore and exploit living and nonliving, organic or nonorganic resources over the specified maritime zones in accordance with the UNCLOS and other existing laws and treaties.
